name: Cover
summary: Cover Effect Light Cover +2 AC against attacks that pass through the cover. Heavy Cover +5 AC against attacks that pass through the cover. Full Cover Cannot be directly targeted through the obstruction. Examples: crates, railings and pipework are usually Light Cover; barricades, firing ports and armoured machinery are usually Heavy Cover; sealed walls and complete corners provide Full Cover. The GM decides whether a line of fire crosses the cover.
